description: The navigable MAP schema: admit SpatialLocation WorldInstances + 4-neighbour adjacency + boundaries, so the agent turns a perceived grid into a routable graph and the spatial-routing faculty (passable_distances_to / plan_passable_step) routes over it. The map-BUILDING (floor cells -> SpatialLocations + adjacent_location) is the materializer; this admits its edges.

microtheory.name: spatial_map
microtheory.description: a grid becomes a map: floor cells are SpatialLocations, orthogonally-adjacent floors are adjacent_location, walls are absent (routed around). The avatar's cell is the locus; a salient cell is the goal.
